tasks.label: Build firmware
tasks.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v ${workspaceFolder}/..:/project -e SDK_PATH=/project/esp-open-rtos espbuilder make -C /project/esp-homekit-wired-thermostat/src -j4

tasks.label: Build bootloader
tasks.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v ${workspaceFolder}/..:/project -e SDK_PATH=/project/esp-open-rtos espbuilder make -C /project/esp-open-rtos/bootloader -j4

tasks.label: Build all (bootloader + firmware)
tasks.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v ${workspaceFolder}/..:/project -e SDK_PATH=/project/esp-open-rtos espbuilder bash -c "make -C /project/esp-open-rtos/bootloader -j4 && make -C /project/esp-homekit-wired-thermostat/src -j4"

tasks.label: Clean build
tasks.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v ${workspaceFolder}/..:/project -e SDK_PATH=/project/esp-open-rtos espbuilder bash -c "make -C /project/esp-homekit-wired-thermostat/src clean && make -C /project/esp-homekit-wired-thermostat/src -j4"
